envDependencies.SAP_FIORI_URL: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_FIORI_URL} in navigation steps
envDependencies.SAP_USERNAME: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_USERNAME} in login step 2
envDependencies.SAP_PASSWORD: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_PASSWORD} in login step 4

TD-CS-032-001.name: Valid Batch Stock View — Manage Stock Navigation
TD-CS-032-001.expectedOutcome: Manage Stock app accessible; batch stock data visible with Material, Batch, Plant, Storage Location, Stock Quantity, Stock Type, and SLED

TD-CS-032-002.name: Expired Batch — Background Job Auto-Restriction
TD-CS-032-002.expectedOutcome: Background job runs; expired batch auto-transferred from Unrestricted to Blocked; notification generated

TD-CS-032-003.name: DESTROY Disposition — Blocked Batch Removal
TD-CS-032-003.expectedOutcome: DESTROY disposition completed; batch removed from blocked stock; audit record created

TD-CS-032-004.name: RETURN Disposition — Blocked Batch Removal
TD-CS-032-004.expectedOutcome: RETURN disposition completed; batch removed from blocked stock; audit record created

TD-CS-032-005.name: REWORK Disposition — Blocked Batch Removal
TD-CS-032-005.expectedOutcome: REWORK disposition completed; batch removed from blocked stock; audit record created

TD-CS-032-006.name: Audit Report — Disposition History Verification
TD-CS-032-006.expectedOutcome: Audit report displays all disposition records with Material, Batch, Action, Date (timestamp), User, and Comments

TD-CS-032-NEG-001.name: No Expired Batches — Job Runs Successfully
TD-CS-032-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: Job runs; 0 batches identified as expired; no transfer occurs; no notification generated

TD-CS-032-NEG-002.name: Batch Already Blocked — No Duplicate Transfer
TD-CS-032-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: Job runs; batch already blocked — no duplicate transfer; no new material document created

TD-CS-032-NEG-003.name: Non-Batch Material — System Skips Processing
TD-CS-032-NEG-003.expectedOutcome: Job runs; material skipped (no batch management enabled); warning logged; job completes successfully

TD-CS-032-NEG-004.name: Missing Blocked Storage Location — Transfer Fails
TD-CS-032-NEG-004.expectedOutcome: Job runs; transfer fails due to missing blocked storage location; error logged; batch remains unrestricted

TD-CS-032-ERR-001.name: Background Job Failure — System Error
TD-CS-032-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: Job fails with ABAP dump or authorization error; job status = Aborted/Error; no stock transfers occur; alert generated

TD-CS-032-ERR-002.name: Material Document Creation Failure
TD-CS-032-ERR-002.expectedOutcome: Job runs; material document creation fails (e.g., fiscal year closed); error logged; batch remains unrestricted

TD-CS-032-ERR-003.name: Notification Send Failure
TD-CS-032-ERR-003.expectedOutcome: Stock transfer succeeds; notification send fails (email/workflow error); error logged; no notification in inbox

TD-CS-032-ERR-004.name: Unauthorized Disposition Attempt
TD-CS-032-ERR-004.expectedOutcome: Disposition rejected with authorization error; batch remains blocked; no disposition record created

TD-CS-032-ERR-005.name: Missing Disposition Action — Validation Error
TD-CS-032-ERR-005.note: Disposition Action field intentionally left blank to test mandatory field validation
TD-CS-032-ERR-005.expectedOutcome: Submission blocked; error: 'Disposition Action is required'; Disposition Action field highlighted

TD-CS-032-ERR-006.name: Audit Report Generation Failure
TD-CS-032-ERR-006.expectedOutcome: Report execution fails (authorization/database error) OR report displays with missing/incomplete data

TD-CS-032-EDGE-001.name: Batch Expires Today — SLED Boundary Condition (Lower)
TD-CS-032-EDGE-001.expectedOutcome: Batch with SLED = today is identified as expired; stock transferred to blocked; notification generated

TD-CS-032-EDGE-002.name: Zero Unrestricted Stock — Stock Quantity Boundary (Lower)
TD-CS-032-EDGE-002.expectedOutcome: Batch identified as expired; no stock to transfer (unrestricted = 0); no material document created; notification generated

TD-CS-032-EDGE-003.name: Multiple Batches Expire Same Day — Batch Count Boundary (Upper)
TD-CS-032-EDGE-003.expectedOutcome: All 3 batches identified as expired in single job run; all transferred to blocked; 3 material documents created

TD-CS-032-EDGE-004.name: Null SLED — Expiration Date Boundary (Null)
TD-CS-032-EDGE-004.note: Batch SLED field is null/blank/not maintained in batch master
TD-CS-032-EDGE-004.expectedOutcome: Batch skipped from expiration processing; warning logged; job completes; batch remains unrestricted
